title: Clarity Fortress Walkthrough
description: Thirteen-step builder funnel for CLRTY-1 sovereign mainnet at dev.clrty.io/labs

steps.label: Discover
steps.description: Read chain spec, PoC tuple, and genesis entropy. CLRTY-1 is the only execution network.

steps.label: Connect
steps.description: Connect wallet via adapter; add network chainId 1202 (9 decimals).

steps.label: Fund
steps.description: Request test uclrty via FMA-governed faucet (non-mainnet clusters).

steps.label: Intent
steps.description: Submit structured intent JSON via clrt prism query.

steps.label: Simulate
steps.description: Run simulateTransaction; review FMA vector and MLX toxicity score.

steps.label: Execute
steps.description: Preview HELIX route and private mempool path.

steps.label: Prove
steps.description: Execution proof and replay hash from explorer.

steps.label: Skills
steps.description: Run MCA/EHL skill modules from clrty CLI.

steps.label: Govern
steps.description: Snapshot vote with FMA proposal gate.

steps.label: Cross-chain
steps.description: ETH bridge telemetry via Alchemy CLI — not L1 execution.

steps.label: Launch
steps.description: Smoke public RPC getSlot and operational dashboard.

steps.label: Register Node
steps.description: Register a custom dev node (free tier) or sovereign tier after Stripe checkout. Persists to var/monetization/node_registry.json.
